item.title: Bits to atoms: what digital fabrication is
item.description: Course overview; shop tour and safety culture; what digital fabrication means for artists and designers; the file → machine → object loop.

learningObjectives.item: Describe the three process families and name a machine for each
Explain the CAD → CAM → machine pipeline
Identify the safety requirements for shop access
Articulate a personal question about making to pursue this term

item.content:
Course overview; shop tour and safety culture; what digital fabrication means for artists and designers; the file → machine → object loop.

Ideas

Additive, subtractive, and formative process families; CAD → CAM → machine; the digital material (files as things); precision and repeatability; the workmanship of certainty vs. risk (Pye).

In class

  • Intro lecture (40 min)
  • shop tour + safety orientation with the lab tech (60 min)
  • object autopsy kickoff (30 min)
